POLITICAL PROFILE / VERIFIED PUBLIC RECORD

Charan Das Mahant

Full career and offices

Veteran Congress leader with experience in the Union government, national legislature, Assembly leadership and party organisation. His recorded public positions in the research window include state governance and tribal inclusion.

CURRENT PUBLIC ROLELeader of the Opposition, Chhattisgarh Assembly; Congress Legislature Party leader
CONSTITUENCY / AREASakti Assembly constituency · elected 2023
MANDATES / TENURESSitting MLA; former Lok Sabha MP and Assembly Speaker
Political career & milestones
  1. 1980s–2000sHeld elected roles in the undivided Madhya Pradesh and later Chhattisgarh political system.
  2. 1998–2014Served three terms in the Lok Sabha, including the Korba parliamentary constituency from 2009 to 2014; earlier electoral history requires seat-by-seat confirmation.
  3. July 2011–October 2012Served as Union Minister of State for Agriculture and Food Processing Industries; subsequent portfolio changes require verification.
  4. 2018–2023Speaker of the Chhattisgarh Legislative Assembly.
  5. 2023–presentSakti MLA and Leader of the Opposition / Congress Legislature Party leader.
Public-policy focus

Legislative opposition, assembly oversight, welfare delivery, representation and constitutional questions.

Collection pipeline

Publicly indexed press-discovery leads are periodically checked and deduplicated; approved, token-authenticated X API collection can be enabled where available. Facebook and Instagram historical organic posts require authorized original-source access or exports. No stealth evasion, CAPTCHA bypass, or invented accounts.

Meta primary-post status: historical Facebook / Instagram corpus not independently verified. Direct public Facebook access returned a temporary block, and indexed Instagram results did not provide a complete dated feed. This tab does not claim 90 days of posts have been scraped. It preserves ten leader profiles per platform and supports validated, source-linked records supplied through permitted access or documented exports. No login evasion, stealth fingerprinting or robots.txt bypass is used.

Import original post evidence

Paste JSON or select a JSON/CSV export containing dated original Meta links. Everything imported here stays in this browser; the live website and GitHub dataset remain unchanged until explicitly reviewed and committed.

Required fields: leader, platform, published_at, url. Optional: text, topics, districts, post_type. Each post must link to a Facebook or Instagram post, photo, video or reel and be within the stated window. CSV list fields use | separators. Use an array or an object with a posts array for JSON.

Imported records are marked “User-supplied · unverified” even if a permalink looks authentic. The tool rejects out-of-range dates, invalid leaders, duplicate URLs, profile-only links and unrelated domains. No automated external requests or uploads occur.

Unconfirmed discovery leads

Third-party reports of social posts are kept apart from original platform permalinks.

Collection rules: 5 August–5 November 2026 (inclusive), five topics: tribal issues, religion/Hinduism, governance, minerals and mining. Meta Graph API and approved exports can provide data when access is authorized; political-ad library results must be labeled paid advertisements, never organic posts. Randomized anti-detection delays, credential circumvention and robots.txt bypass are not part of this implementation.

DATA PROVENANCE & COLLECTION PLAN

Coverage, Gaps & Collection Controls

Every indexed article/video is traceable to its publisher URL. Missing X posts or absent outlets indicate collection gaps, not absence of political activity.

Included now

161 source-linked items with dates and original article/video URLs. All 10 people represented and five dossier categories searchable, plus a separate government-criticism tag.

Not complete

No full historical X or Meta post archive; a small number of directly linked YouTube uploads; several source channels unverified. Do not treat zeros as inactivity.

Verification rule

Preserve original URL, outlet, published date, type of event, allegation qualifiers, deduplication provenance and collection timestamp when importing.

Data operations

File-based import and local edits; scripts do not run inside the preview

Review source registryReview X accounts

The browser stores records imported on this device, if supported. Seed totals on the Command Centre remain a fixed verified-link snapshot; imported records appear in the Archive. Use CSV or JSON export before switching browsers. Full historical collection requires a backend or authorised API access, not an HTML file.

Issue coding guide

No inference about a leader’s personal identity or beliefs

Religion / Hinduism means publicly reported religious festivals, sites or policy statements, not a claim about anyone’s faith. “Government criticism” covers attributed challenges to government, not an endorsement of them. Minerals refers to mineral-resource policy; mining refers to extraction and coal/mine operations.
